title: DGM-Product Strategy & Solutions Architecture
description:
We are looking for a Deputy General Manager who will own a portfolio of strategic technology programmes at Tata Communications, ranging across network products, AI solutions, security and trust, and emerging federated network architectures. The role is equally about deep solutioning and broad collaboration : the successful candidate will architect end-to-end solutions for senior internal stakeholders and enterprise customers, drive multiple high-impact strategic partnerships in parallel (OEMs, hyperscale's, academia, standards bodies, customer co-innovation), and translate Tata Communications' technology strategy into measurable commercial outcomes. The successful candidate will be equally credible in a customer CTO conversation, an OEM negotiation, an engineering design review, and a board-level update. Key Responsibilities Solutioning and Solution Architecture. Architect and orchestrate end-to-end solutions for enterprise and carrier customers across the full Tata Communications portfolio connectivity, security, AI infrastructure, data platforms, and emerging federated architectures. Lead deep technical discussions with senior management, customer CXOs, and Tata Communications' executive committee. Translate complex requirements into deployable architectures with clear commercial and operational implications. Strategic Collaborations and Partnership Portfolio. Own and drive a portfolio of high-impact strategic collaborations across multiple counterpart types: OEMs and technology vendors evaluation, onboarding, joint roadmaps, joint go-to-market. Hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) — joint solutions and integrated offerings. Academic institutions — research collaborations with the IITs, IISc, and international universities on emerging technology (quantum, post-quantum, AI, networking). Standards bodies and industry consortia — ITU-T, ETSI, IETF, TM Forum, GSMA, and equivalent. Customer co-innovation programmes — joint design and pilot engagements with strategic enterprise and carrier customers. The candidate will manage several of these collaborations concurrently, set the strategy for each, negotiate technical and commercial terms, and drive them through to measurable outcomes. Productization of AI Workloads. Oversee the productization of AI workloads — model serving, agentic systems, AI-augmented network and security operations, and customer-facing AI features — on Tata Communications infrastructure. Define product requirements, drive engineering execution, manage release governance, and own commercial readiness, including performance, observability, cost, and responsible-AI compliance. Productization of Federated, Intent-Driven Network Programmes. Lead the productization of one or more flagship network programmes that couple multi-domain connectivity, security and identity, federated governance, and intent-driven orchestration across the underlay and overlay. Current programmes include Quantum-Safe Networking, intent-based and policy-driven network automation, SASE evolution, and federated network and data architectures across enterprise and carrier customers. The candidate will be expected to own one of these as the primary workstream while contributing to the others as their portfolio matures. Solutioning Excellence with OEMs and Partners. Convert OEM and partner capabilities into deployable Tata Communications solutions: identify integration points, design joint solution stacks, lead proof-of-concepts, and drive the implementation lifecycle with partner and internal engineering teams. Ensure that partner relationships translate into customer-facing value rather than abstract MOUs. Internal Cross-Functional Leadership. Build durable cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Architecture, Product Management, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Procurement, and Customer Success. Operate as a credible bridge between technical and commercial functions and as a senior-management-facing voice for the product portfolio. Strategy Execution and Results Ownership. Translate organizational strategy into measurable outcomes. Maintain quantitative dashboards on adoption, deployment, revenue impact, customer satisfaction, partner health, and programmes execution. Drive quarterly business reviews and proactively unblock cross-functional dependencies. Operate with a clear "outcomes over activity" discipline. Talent and Technical Leadership. Mentor solution architects, product managers, and engineering leads in your matrix. Set the bar for technical depth, customer empathy, partnership stewardship, and executive communication. Champion a culture of solutioning excellence and strategic clarity. Required Qualifications Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics & Communication, Information Technology, or a closely related engineering discipline from a recognized institution. A management qualification (MBA, PGDM, or equivalent) is strongly preferred — the role explicitly requires a mix of computer-science depth and management acumen. Experience: 12–16 years of progressive experience in enterprise network products, telecom infrastructure, AI/ML productization, cloud platforms, or cybersecurity, with at least 4 years at a senior individual-contributor or leadership level driving cross-functional and cross-organizational initiatives. Technical depth in at least three of the following: Networking and connectivity — SD-WAN, SASE, SR-MPLS / SRv6, intent-based and policy-driven network automation (e.g., RFC 9315 IBN, TMF921), streaming telemetry (gNMI / OpenConfig), programmable data planes. Security, identity and trust — Zero Trust, identity and access management, federated identity (e.g., W3C DID and Verifiable Credentials), post-quantum cryptography, key and secret management. AI/ML productization — model deployment, MLOps, agentic systems, observability, responsible AI. Federated and decentralized data architectures — domain-oriented decentralized data ownership, federated data and policy governance, data-as-a-product thinking, policy-as-code. Cloud and hyperscaler architectures — AWS, Azure, GCP; multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud connectivity; service mesh and microservice patterns. Demonstrated track record of: Taking products from concept through commercial deployment at meaningful scale. Driving multiple strategic collaborations in parallel — OEMs, hyperscale's, academia, or standards bodies. Engaging at CXO level both internally and with enterprise customers. Operating in a matrixed, multi-stakeholder environment. Preferred Qualifications Exposure to federated data and policy architectures, decentralized data ownership models, or domain-oriented data platforms. Familiarity with intent-based networking standards (RFC 9315, TMF921), service-mesh patterns applied to network functions, or programmable data planes (P4 / eBPF). Familiarity with Quantum-Safe Networking, post-quantum cryptography, or QKD. Hyperscale partnership experience (AWS, Azure, GCP) at the product-engineering level. Established relationships with global networking, security, or AI OEMs. Active participation in standards bodies or industry consortia. Academic-industry collaboration experience (joint research programmes, sponsored research, joint publications). Industry recognition through patents, peer-reviewed publications, standards contributions, or conference talks. Behavioral Competencies Self-motivated — operates with high agency across multiple parallel workstreams; does not require oversight to make progress. Strategy-driven — translates ambiguity into clear, executable plans across diverse programmes. Results-oriented — committed to measurable outcomes over activity. Executive communication — credible and concise with senior leadership, OEM executives, customer CXOs, and academic principals. Partnership stewardship — builds and sustains long-term collaborative relationships with external counterparts. Stakeholder management — earns trust across engineering, product, sales, partners, customers, and standards / academic communities. Intellectual curiosity — actively tracks emerging technology (AI, post-quantum, 6G, federated architectures, agentic systems) and brings external insight back into the organisation. Comfort with ambiguity — thrives at the intersection of new technology, evolving markets, and multi-counterparty dependencies.

title: Lead,Tech Product Owner
description:
About Consilio Consilio is a global leader in eDiscovery, document review, legal talent, and consulting services, helping organizations navigate complex legal and business challenges. Job Summary: The Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) Technical Product Owner is accountable for defining, prioritizing, and delivering EDW capabilities that create measurable value for internal clients and business stakeholders. This role establishes product direction, maintains a clear and actionable backlog, and serves as the primary decision-maker for scope and priority throughout the delivery lifecycle. The Technical Product Owner partners closely with stakeholders, data engineers, developers, architects, project managers, and technical leads to translate strategic objectives and operational needs into product outcomes, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release plans. The role supports enterprise data solutions across relational databases, reporting platforms, ERP and CRM applications, middleware and iPaaS platforms, and proprietary systems. Success requires strong product judgment, technical fluency, stakeholder leadership, disciplined prioritization, clear communication, and the ability to make informed trade-offs among value, risk, effort, dependencies, and delivery timelines. Responsibilities Own the product vision, goals, roadmap, and delivery priorities for assigned data warehouse, reporting, and integration capabilities. Serve as the primary point of accountability for product scope, backlog quality, prioritization, and acceptance decisions. Partner with sponsors, stakeholders, subject matter experts, and technical teams to define desired outcomes, success measures, and product requirements. Create, refine, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog, including epics, features, user stories, technical enablement work, defects, and operational improvements. Develop clear user stories and acceptance criteria that communicate business value, expected behavior, data requirements, and quality expectations. Balance stakeholder demand, strategic alignment, technical dependencies, risk, capacity, and delivery effort when making priority and sequencing decisions. Lead backlog refinement and actively participate in sprint planning, reviews, demonstrations, release planning, and retrospectives. Provide timely product decisions and clarify scope, intent, and acceptance criteria so delivery teams can proceed without avoidable delays. Collaborate with engineering and architecture teams on solution options while maintaining accountability for product outcomes rather than prescribing implementation details. Coordinate dependencies across source systems, data integrations, enterprise data warehouse processes, semantic models, reports, and downstream consumers. Ensure data quality, security, privacy, governance, auditability, and supportability considerations are represented in product priorities and acceptance criteria. Engage stakeholders throughout delivery, communicate roadmap and release expectations, and manage changes to scope or priority transparently. Coordinate user acceptance testing by defining expected outcomes, identifying appropriate participants, reviewing results, and determining readiness for release. Accept or reject completed work based on agreed acceptance criteria and product quality expectations. Monitor production feedback, adoption, defects, support trends, and changing business needs to guide continuous product improvement. Identify and escalate delivery risks, unresolved dependencies, resource constraints, and decisions requiring leadership attention. Maintain product documentation and provide release communication, knowledge transfer, and training support as needed. Qualifications Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, Business, or equivalent relevant experience. Experience serving as a Product Owner, Technical Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar role for data, or analytics products. Demonstrated experience owning and prioritizing a product backlog and writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Working knowledge of Agile and Scrum practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and release planning. Experience working with relational databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or equivalent platforms, including a practical understanding of SQL and data structures. Experience collaborating with technical teams delivering data warehouse, reporting, or data pipeline solutions. Experience using Jira or an equivalent product planning and work management platform. Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, negotiation, decision-making, and written and verbal communication skills. Ability to understand technical concepts, evaluate delivery trade-offs, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience defining product outcomes, acceptance measures, and release readiness. Preferred Experience: Knowledge of enterprise data warehouse architecture, dimensional modeling, ETL or ELT patterns, data quality, metadata, and data governance. Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, Power BI, Python-based data pipelines, or comparable data engineering and analytics technologies. Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, ServiceNow, SnapLogic, or similar enterprise applications and integration platforms. Experience managing products that ingest data from multiple source systems and serve reporting, analytics, and operational use cases. Knowledge of software development lifecycle practices, test planning, production support, and release management. Project management experience or experience coordinating cross-team initiatives and dependencies. Experience in eDiscovery or legal technology is preferred but not required. Proficiency with Microsoft 365 products, including Power BI, Excel, OneNote, and Teams. Core Competencies: Product ownership and accountability Roadmap and backlog management Value-based prioritization and trade-off decisions Technical and data fluency Stakeholder alignment and expectation management Agile delivery leadership Clear written and verbal communication Risk, dependency, and release management Analytical problem-solving and continuous improvement Work Model 3 days Work from Office 2 days Work from Home Shift Timing 7:00 PM to 4:00 AM night shift Consilio s True North Values Client Experience | Listen for the why . Grit | Focus on what matters . Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner . Deliver results you re proud of. This role requires strong technical fluency and comfort operating in an agile delivery environment. You will represent the voice of the user in engineering forums, drive clarity through well-formed requirements and acceptance criteria, and create transparency into prioritization decisions and delivery progress. As a senior individual contributor, you will demonstrate strong product management craft, influence without authority, and operational excellence. You will help raise the bar on how product decisions are madeusing customer evidence, market insight, and data-driven metrics to guide prioritization and trade-offs. In this role, you will also play a critical part in stakeholder engagement responding to customer issues that impact product success. Success requires strong communication, comfort navigating ambiguity, and the ability to drive alignment across teams toward shared outcomes. Main responsibilities Product Execution Delivery Opportunity Definition: Prepare and manage Opportunity Canvases and related Initiatives, defining objectives, value propositions, success measures, priorities, and delivery scope in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. Backlog Ownership: Own the product backlog for your scope: intake, triage, refinement, prioritization, and readiness for development. Requirements Scenarios: Translate user needs and cross-product scenarios into clear requirements (user stories, functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria) that RD can implement. Delivery Planning: Partner with RD to define milestones, sequencing, and release plans; proactively manage risks, dependencies, and scope trade-offs. Technical Reviews: Participate in technical and development reviews; provide product input on implementation decisions to ensure usability, supportability, security, and scalability. Release Readiness: Drive product release strategy and readiness by coordinating engineering, documentation, support, services, marketing, and enablement activities. Outcome Validation: Ensure high-quality outcomes by defining success criteria, validating solutions (customer/field feedback), and driving iteration. Customer Internal Engagement Voice of the Customer: Serve as the trusted voice of the customerensuring product decisions are grounded in real user problems and that customer feedback is systematically incorporated. title: Digital Product Architect
description:
About DataZymes
DataZymes is a data analytics company delivering actionable intelligence and digital solutions. We are setting up a brand-new Digital Product Centre of Excellence (COE) in Bengaluru to design, build and scale AI-native enterprise products.

The Role
We are hiring a hands-on Digital Product Architect to build our Digital Product COE from zero to one. You will define the technical vision, build the engineering team from the ground up, and stay hands-on in the code. You will architect enterprise-scale applications that combine full-stack engineering (Java / .NET, React / Angular) with Generative AI (LLMs, RAG, AI agents, Vector and Graph databases).

Key Responsibilities
• COE Setup & Leadership: Set up the Digital Product COE. Hire, mentor and lead a team of full-stack engineers and AI engineers. Define coding standards, CI/CD pipelines and Agile delivery practices.
• Solution Architecture: Design scalable, secure microservices architecture for high-volume data workloads and real-time AI inference.
• Hands-on Full Stack Development: Write production code across the stack. Build backends in Java (Spring Boot) and/or .NET Core (C#), and frontends in React and/or Angular.
• Generative AI & LLM Integration: Build AI-driven applications using LLMs such as Claude, Gemini and GPT-4. Design and build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines on enterprise data.
• AI Agents & Orchestration: Build AI agents, copilots and semantic search using LangChain / LangGraph and the GitHub Agent SDK.
• Database Design: Design data models using Vector Databases (semantic search, LLM context retrieval) and Graph Databases (knowledge graphs, relationship mapping).
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Work with Product Managers, Data Scientists and leadership to turn business needs into technical blueprints and ship products.

Must-Have Skills
• 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 3–5 years as a Solution Architect / Technical Architect / Technical Lead
• Hands-on expertise in Java (Spring Boot, Hibernate) OR .NET (C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET)
• Hands-on expertise in React OR Angular, with TypeScript
• Hands-on Generative AI experience: built and deployed RAG pipelines and LLM-based applications in production
• Experience with LangChain (or LangGraph / LlamaIndex / Semantic Kernel)
• Experience with at least one Vector Database: Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector or FAISS
• Strong knowledge of Microservices, RESTful APIs and Event-Driven Architecture
• Cloud experience on AWS, Azure or GCP, plus Docker and Kubernetes
• Track record of building enterprise SaaS platforms or data-heavy applications from scratch

Good-to-Have Skills
• Hands-on in both Java and .NET, and both React and Angular
• Graph Databases: Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Knowledge Graphs
• AI Agents / Agentic AI, GitHub Agent SDK, copilot development
• LLM APIs: OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini
• gRPC, Kafka, Redux / NgRx, Tailwind / Material UI
• Experience in life sciences, pharma or healthcare analytics
• Experience setting up an engineering team or COE

Who You Are
• A builder: as comfortable whiteboarding an architecture as debugging a React component or tuning a LangChain prompt
• Still writes code every week, not only reviews it
• Explains complex AI and technology concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders

title: Product Owner: Securities and Prime Services Delivery (VP)
description:
Job Summary 
 Wells Fargo is seeking an experienced Product Owner (individual contributor) for planning, coordination, and delivering enhancements across Client Reporting, Client Portal, Trade Processing, and Client Billing platforms. The Product Owner manages the backlog, documents requirements, drives Agile delivery, coordinates stakeholders, leads release readiness, and delivers executive reporting to ensure successful execution of strategic, operational, and regulatory initiatives. 

 Responsibilities 
 Lead delivery management activities for assigned product capabilities within the Securities and Prime Services organization, partnering with global product managers and technology teams to manage execution, dependencies, risks, and delivery commitments. 

 Functional and Technical Skills 

 Product Ownership 
 Execute the product roadmap across Client Reporting, Client Portals, Trade Processing, and Client Billing platforms. Evaluate business requests, operational needs, client feedback, and regulatory requirements to prioritize the backlog and plan delivery. Maintain visibility into product initiatives, dependencies, milestones, and delivery commitments. Manage quarterly planning activities, including Big Room Planning (BRP), capacity reviews, dependency management, and roadmap coordination. Manage the product demand and intake process, ensuring requests are documented, tracked, and routed appropriately. 

 Agile Delivery Product Ownership 
 Create, refine, and maintain Epics, Features, and User Stories in Jira. Partner with Business Analysts and Technology teams to translate business requirements into actionable work items. Manage backlog grooming, sprint planning, story refinement, and prioritization sessions. Lead Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, retrospectives, backlog reviews, and daily scrum meetings as needed. Track delivery progress, identify risks and dependencies, and escalate issues when appropriate. Lead user acceptance testing, defect triage, and production validation activities. Evaluate solution options and document impacts to operational workflows and client processes. 

 Stakeholder Coordination Governance 
 Coordinate Product, Operations, Technology, Client Service, Finance, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders to drive delivery activities. Drive communication and coordination across multiple workstreams and delivery teams. Maintain action item, decision, and issue logs for key initiatives. 

 Business Continuity and Operational Readiness 
 Lead client readiness planning and implementation activities for new product capabilities and enhancements. Lead business continuity planning (BCP) exercises and operational readiness reviews. Coordinate stakeholder communications, training materials, and rollout activities. Manage and respond to internal and external inquiries related to product capabilities and ongoing initiatives. 

 Product Domains 
 Client Portal and digital client experience solutions. Trade Processing and post-trade operational workflows. Client Billing and fee management solutions. Regulatory, operational, and client service enhancements across the Securities and Prime Services product suite. 

 Executive Communication 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with clients, product specialists, technology teams and senior leaders across global businesses. Create concise, executive-ready presentations and updates that clearly explain outcomes, delivery status, trade-offs, risks and decisions required. Translate complex markets, platform and operational issues into clear, outcome-oriented conversations. Build strong communication channels and trusted relationships across business, operations, control and technology partners. Use AI-supported summaries and narratives judiciously for executive communication, ensuring accuracy, context and appropriate review. 

 Change Mindset and Collaboration 
 Work effectively at the intersection of business domain expertise, product ownership and project management. Collaborate across global teams to shape solutions, resolve dependencies and drive decisions through to implementation. Challenge existing processes constructively and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, control and user experience. Demonstrate adaptability, curiosity and continuous learning, including responsible adoption of emerging AI capabilities to increase delivery velocity. 

 Risk Control Mindset 
 Embed risk and control considerations into product design, prioritization, testing and implementation. Ensure product capabilities and delivery processes comply with applicable SEC, FINRA and FRB requirements and Wells Fargo's risk frameworks. Identify and escalate delivery, operational, conduct, regulatory and technology risks in a timely manner. Ensure responsible AI use with awareness of data privacy, information security, ethical and regulatory requirements. 

 Required Qualifications 
 5+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education MBA or equivalent relevant experience. 5+ years of experience across Securities, Capital Markets, Prime Brokerage, Trade Processing, Client Reporting, or Billing workflows preferred. Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies and Jira. Strong organizational and project coordination skills. Experience collaborating with business, operations, and technology stakeholders. Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to create executive-ready presentations and present information to persuade, educate, and enhance understanding at all levels. Ability to work effectively in a demanding, fast-paced, dynamic environment, handling multiple tasks and projects concurrently while maintaining quality, accuracy, integrity, accountability, and attention to detail. Ability to work in a global team, interact at different levels, and manage deliverables with varying levels of complexity, with a focus on execution and results. Advanced Microsoft Office skills, including PowerPoint, Word, and Excel. Experience identifying and driving process improvements in complex environments. 

 Work Arrangement and Shift Timings 
 Work Model: Hybrid working model with a minimum requirement of three (3) days per week from office. Flexibility: The role requires reasonable flexibility to attend stakeholder meetings or calls as needed during US business hours and to provide support for weekend activities, as required, particularly during release and deployment windows.

description:

It is the largest managed health care company in the Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) Association serving more than 112 million individuals across 14 states. A regular in Fortune 500 list, Elevance Health ranked 18 in 2026. Gail Boudreaux , President and CEO of Elevance Health has been a consistent name in the Fortune list of most powerful women and currently holds 81st rank on this list. ABOUT CARELON GLOBAL SOLUTIONS Carelon Global Solutions (CGS) is a healthcare solutions company simplifying complex operational processes to improve the health of the healthcare system. Previously known as Legato Health Technologies, Carelon Global Solutions (hereinafter, CGS) underwent a name change and joined the Carelon family of brands in January 2023, as a fully owned subsidiary of Elevance Health (Previously Anthem Inc.). CGS brings together a global team of like-minded innovators who manage and optimize operational processes for health plans as well as providers. Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective, and efficient. OUR MISSION & VALUES Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.
 Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity JOB PURPOSE Carelon Global Solutions India is seeking a Senior Manager Architecture to lead architecture and end-to-end implementation of enterprise pharmacy management capabilities for CarelonRx. The role owns technical vision, solution architecture, engineering execution, implementation readiness, and platform outcomes across complex, multi-system pharmacy transformation programs. The position is intentionally weighted toward architecture, engineering, AI-enabled Spec-Driven Development, and large-scale implementation leadership. Delivery administration is a supporting responsibility, not the primary mandate. The leader will combine strong software engineering depth with practical pharmacy and PBM domain knowledge to translate business capabilities into secure, scalable, resilient, and operable platforms. JOB RESPONSIBILITY Enterprise Pharmacy Architecture Define and govern target-state solution architecture for end-to-end pharmacy management systems, aligned with enterprise architecture, security, data, privacy, resiliency, and regulatory guardrails. Create capability maps, domain boundaries, reference architectures, reusable patterns, integration standards, and modernization roadmaps across the pharmacy ecosystem. Lead architecture decisions for microservices, APIs, event streaming, workflow orchestration, data platforms, cloud-native services, observability, and interoperability with legacy platforms. Own architecture reviews, trade-off decisions, non-functional requirements, technical debt strategy, and design assurance from concept through production adoption. End-To-End Pharmacy Platform Implementation Lead implementation across relevant pharmacy and PBM capabilities such as benefit configuration, formulary, eligibility, claims adjudication, pricing, prior authorization, pharmacy networks, specialty pharmacy, clinical programs, rebates, member and provider experiences, and operational reporting. Translate business journeys and pharmacy operating models into domain-aligned services, data contracts, interfaces, implementation increments, migration plans, and measurable acceptance criteria. Own the technical implementation lifecycle covering discovery, architecture, engineering, integration, data conversion, testing strategy, cutover, production readiness, stabilization, and benefits realization. Manage cross-platform dependencies and ensure that application, data, infrastructure, security, operations, and vendor workstreams converge into one implementable solution. Drive phased rollout, coexistence, migration, and decommissioning strategies that protect member, client, pharmacy, and operational continuity. AI-Enabled Spec-Driven Development (SDD) Establish an AI-first Spec-Driven Development approach in which approved business, architecture, interface, security, testing, and operational specifications become the governed source for implementation. Enable engineering agents and copilots to accelerate design elaboration, code generation, test creation, documentation, code review, traceability, and impact analysis, with human review and approval at critical control points. Define reusable SDD templates, prompt and context standards, repository conventions, quality gates, evaluation criteria, and responsible AI controls for enterprise adoption. Measure SDD outcomes using baselines and agreed targets for engineering cycle time, specification-to-code traceability, automated test coverage, escaped defects, rework, deployment frequency, and productivity improvement. Ensure AI-generated artifacts meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, intellectual property, explainability, maintainability, and auditability. Engineering Excellence And Hands-On Technical Leadership Provide credible, hands-on technical leadership through design reviews, code and API reviews, proof-of-concept direction, critical problem solving, performance analysis, and production diagnostics. Guide teams on software design principles, domain-driven design, secure coding, automated testing, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, reliability engineering, and cloud cost optimization. Define engineering scorecards and quality gates covering code health, architecture compliance, security vulnerabilities, reliability, performance, recoverability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Champion platform engineering, reusable services, developer experience, automated environments, and self-service capabilities that reduce implementation friction at scale. Large-Scale Implementation Leadership Lead multiple engineering teams and technical workstreams across product, architecture, software engineering, data, quality engineering, cloud, security, operations, and partner organizations. Create an integrated technical implementation plan that connects architecture runway, dependency sequencing, environment readiness, test strategy, migration, cutover, and operational acceptance. Act as the senior technical decision-maker for complex implementation risks, cross-team conflicts, architecture exceptions, integration failures, and production-readiness gaps. Provide transparent executive-level reporting on architecture health, implementation progress, critical dependencies, risk exposure, quality, readiness, and realized business outcomes. Build governance that is lightweight but effective, emphasizing decision velocity, measurable technical outcomes, and removal of systemic blockers rather than delivery administration. Pharmacy Domain And Stakeholder Partnership Apply working knowledge of the prescription lifecycle, PBM operations, payer and pharmacy interactions, clinical and utilization management, drug data, pricing, formulary, claims, and applicable industry transactions and regulations. Partner with pharmacy business leaders, product managers, enterprise architects, security, operations, compliance, and client teams to shape solutions that are technically sound and operationally adoptable. Convert domain policies, rules, and exceptions into explicit specifications, testable requirements, decision services, and traceable implementation controls. Challenge assumptions using outside-in engineering and pharmacy-platform practices while tailoring recommendations to CarelonRx business priorities and enterprise constraints. People And Capability Leadership Build, lead, and mentor engineering managers, solution architects, principal engineers, technical leads, developers, quality engineers, and platform specialists across distributed teams. Establish clear technical accountabilities, architecture ownership, engineering career paths, succession plans, and communities of practice for pharmacy engineering and AI SDD. Create a culture of engineering rigor, transparent decision-making, experimentation, learning, inclusion, and accountability for outcomes. Assess capability gaps and execute hiring, upskilling, partner augmentation, and workforce plans required for large-scale implementation. Delivery Governance As A Supporting Responsibility Partner with product and program leadership on planning, investment sequencing, release readiness, dependency management, and risk escalation. Use delivery metrics only as supporting indicators. Primary accountability remains architecture quality, end-to-end implementation integrity, engineering excellence, and business capability outcomes. Ensure commitments are realistic, technically grounded, and supported by clear specifications, measurable acceptance criteria, and production-readiness evidence. QUALIFICATION Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred. Strong foundation in software engineering, enterprise solution architecture, systems integration, cloud engineering, data architecture, cybersecurity, and operational resilience. Demonstrated ability to communicate architecture and implementation choices to business executives, product leaders, engineers, risk partners, and external vendors. Ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based trade-offs, and connect pharmacy business outcomes to technical architecture and implementation decisions. Working knowledge of Agile, product operating models, DevSecOps, secure SDLC, and modern engineering governance. EXPERIENCE 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise platforms, and technology implementation, including 5+ years leading engineering managers, architects, or large technical teams. Proven leadership of large-scale, multi-year enterprise implementations involving multiple applications, complex integrations, data migration, cloud platforms, distributed teams, and production cutover. Relevant healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM experience, with demonstrable understanding of end-to-end pharmacy capabilities and their technology implications. Demonstrated experience defining target architecture and taking complex platforms from architecture through implementation, production readiness, stabilization, and measurable adoption. Experience applying AI-assisted engineering, Spec-Driven Development, agentic workflows, or comparable automation across the SDLC with appropriate human oversight and governance. Experience managing strategic vendors and globally distributed teams while retaining internal ownership of architecture, engineering quality, and implementation outcomes. Experience modernizing legacy systems using APIs, microservices, event-driven patterns, cloud-native platforms, automated testing, DevSecOps, observability, and reliability practices. SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES Core Technical Competencies Enterprise and solution architecture; domain-driven design; capability modeling; microservices; API-first and event-driven architecture; integration and interoperability patterns. Java and/or .NET engineering ecosystems; REST and GraphQL APIs; event-streaming platforms; containers and Kubernetes; Azure and/or AWS; CI/CD; infrastructure as code; observability and SRE practices. Data architecture, master and reference data, transactional and analytical data patterns, data quality, lineage, privacy, and secure information exchange. Architecture fitness functions, performance engineering, resilience, disaster recovery, security-by-design, threat modeling, and production operability. Pharmacy And Healthcare Domain Competencies Prescription and pharmacy claims lifecycle; benefit configuration; formulary and utilization management; eligibility; pricing; pharmacy networks; specialty and mail pharmacy; clinical programs; rebates; member and provider journeys. Awareness of healthcare and pharmacy interoperability, transaction standards, regulatory obligations, data privacy, and audit requirements relevant to the assigned platform scope. AI and SDD Competencies Spec-Driven Development, AI-assisted software engineering, agent orchestration, retrieval and context patterns, prompt and evaluation practices, automated testing, traceability, and responsible AI governance. Ability to establish engineering baselines, controlled pilots, adoption guardrails, and measurable value realization for AI-enabled development. Leadership Competencies Strategic thinking, systems thinking, executive communication, architecture decision-making, technical talent development, vendor leadership, influencing without authority, and crisis leadership. Bias for simplification, measurable outcomes, engineering quality, operational accountability, and continuous improvement. Preferred Certifications Cloud architecture certification in Azure or AWS. AI, machine learning, responsible AI, or generative AI certification. Healthcare or pharmacy domain certification, where applicable. SAFe Agilist or equivalent product and Agile leadership certification. Indicative Success Measures Architecture: target-state adoption, design conformance, reuse, technical debt reduction, resilience, security, and platform scalability. Implementation: capability readiness, integration completeness, migration quality, cutover readiness, production stability, adoption, and business outcome realization. Engineering: cycle-time improvement, automation coverage, defect escape reduction, reliability, developer experience, and maintainability. AI SDD: specification coverage and traceability, governed AI adoption, reusable agent workflows, quality of generated artifacts, and validated productivity benefits. Organization: critical-skill coverage, leadership bench strength, team health, succession readiness, and growth of architecture and engineering capability. Delivery: predictable release support and governance compliance, intentionally weighted below architecture, implementation, engineering, and business outcomes. title: Technical Product Manager
description:
TransUnions Job Applicant Privacy Notice Team Overview We are seeking a Technical Product Manager who owns technical delivery and application solution outcomes for a major product area or
program workstream. This role partners closely with internal business resources and technical teams to analyze requirements and drive the
end-to-end design, development or development oversight, testing, implementation, delivery, and documentation of data processing solutions.
 
In this role, you will help sequence the roadmap for the next 2-3 Program Increments (PIs), ensure delivery commitments are feasible and well documented, and coordinate across scrum teams to support successful solution design, build, release, adoption, and ongoing improvement. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
 Role Overview And Core Responsibilities Agile & Scrum Leadership Lead delivery of strategic Alternative Credit initiatives, including Alternative Data products, Blended Score capabilities, score deployment efforts, data provider integrations, compliance enhancements, platform modernization, and customer onboarding requirements. Own technical delivery and application solution execution for a major product area or program workstream; lead delivery across multiple scrum teams so requirements, solution designs, development work, testing, documentation, implementation, and release activities are sequenced, staffed, and ready for iterative delivery. Convert business strategy and stakeholder requirements into clear priorities, a sequenced roadmap, and actionable epics and stories; secure alignment across business, architecture, engineering, compliance, and delivery teams before commitment and maintain traceability from outcomes to requirements, user stories, releases, and supporting documentation. Manage cross-functional dependencies across product, engineering, analytics, operations, architecture, and support teams so plans are feasible and credible; surface risks early, coordinate mitigations across teams, and remove impediments before they become urgent. Escalate the right issues with clear options and trade-offs and drive timely decisions; facilitate prioritization and sequencing based on impact, feasibility, risk, and readiness. Cross Functional Program Leadership Partner closely with Data Science, Analytics, Product Management, Compliance, and Engineering teams to support the development, implementation, monitoring, and evolution of Alternative and Blended Score products. Coordinate dependencies related to data acquisition, model deployment, score production, validation, operational readiness, and customer adoption. Drive roadmap planning and execution for the FactorTrust platform and Alternative Credit ecosystem, balancing technical debt reduction, regulatory requirements, infrastructure modernization, product enhancements, and strategic growth initiatives. Partner with internal business resources and technical teams in a matrixed environment-including solutions/product, engineering, architecture, UX, data science/analytics, compliance, legal, product marketing, operations, and support-to analyze requirements, align on outcomes, and coordinate delivery commitments. Define and maintain a roadmap for the next 2-3 PIs for your product area/workstream; influence yearly planning and coordinate cross-team sequencing and dependencies. Run KPI-driven reviews and adjust the plan to maximize measurable outcomes; use delivery, quality, performance, and operational signals to surface improvement opportunities and drive changes that increase customer value, improve flow, and strengthen solution resiliency. Product Development Lifecycle Ownership Guide the full product and technical delivery lifecycle-from discovery through launch and iteration-ensuring readiness at each stage, including requirements analysis, solution definition, application design, development oversight, testing, delivery, release, adoption, and documentation. Translate customer, business, and stakeholder needs into actionable outcomes and deliverables for multiple teams, accounting for system boundaries, architecture constraints, dependencies, performance considerations, data movement,integrations, and operating model impacts. Own and communicate a sequenced roadmap and backlog; continually re-plan based on KPI performance, impact, feasibility, risk, and readiness while tracking medium-term risks and opportunities. Lead discovery workshops, requirements analysis, and technical solution discussions for foundational and high-visibility initiatives; evaluate options and trade-offs, align on approach, and drive end-to-end execution across teams and partner teams. Lead requirements definition and technical execution for credit risk products that leverage alternative data, including consumer reporting solutions, score development initiatives, prescreening capabilities, identity and fraud inputs, decisioning integrations, and customer-facing product enhancements. Ensure product designs and implementations support regulatory, operational, and customer requirements, including FCRA compliance, model governance standards, audit readiness, data quality controls, and appropriate use of consumer data 
 Required Knowledge And Experiences Technical Expectations A Technical Product Manager owns technical delivery outcomes and understands architecture patterns, application design considerations, data processing concepts, integration points, platform constraints, and application lifecycle practices. This role works directly with engineering to shape, oversee, and deliver sound technical solutions for high-volume, data-driven product platforms. Drive application solution ownership for high-volume, data-driven systems and credit risk platforms, including Alternative Data products, FactorTrust capabilities, Blended Scores, and supporting decisioning services by shaping the application design, development approach, testing strategy, implementation plan, operational readiness, and delivery documentation with engineering teams. Design or oversee the design and development of data processing solutions, including solution decomposition, application framework considerations, data movement, system integrations, performance, resiliency, debugging, and environment readiness. Provide technical direction for Ab Initio-based or similar data processing solutions, including Continuous Flows, application frameworks, performance tuning, debugging, metadata usage, and reusable patterns that can be leveraged by other applications or processes. Create and maintain clear documentation that communicates requirements, technical context, decisions, risks, trade-offs, and delivery status for business stakeholders, developers, and senior leaders. Identify opportunities to improve tools, processes, services, and system integrations that enable end-user productivity, delivery efficiency, and consistent product execution. Collaborate with Data Science and Analytics teams to translate model requirements into scalable production solutions, including score generation workflows, feature engineering requirements, model deployment processes, monitoring frameworks, and performance measurement capabilities. Understand credit bureau, alternative data, and blended scoring ecosystems, including data sourcing, consumer reporting requirements, score implementation considerations, model performance monitoring, and client integration patterns. Leadership Expectations Leads through influence across teams and partner organizations, secures alignment on direction and trade-offs, and operates with sustained independence while driving delivery, measurable outcomes, quality documentation, and continuous improvement. Influence strategic direction for Alternative Credit and FactorTrust initiatives by aligning business objectives, customer needs, regulatory requirements, data science priorities, and technology investments into a cohesive delivery roadmap. 
Qualifications Typically 8+ years of experience in technical product management, application development, engineering, systems analysis, data processing solution delivery, or related product-focused technical roles, including ownership of a product area or program workstream and leadership across multiple delivery teams. Demonstrated experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe delivery environments and driving iterative delivery from requirements through development, testing, release, and post-launch adoption. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate and document technical concepts, requirements, risks, decisions, and delivery status for business stakeholders, developers, and senior leaders. Demonstrated ability to partner with technical teams on application design, data processing solution development, implementation planning, performance considerations, debugging, operational readiness, and process improvement initiatives. Experience with data-driven platforms, application ecosystems, cloud services, integration patterns, or related technical environments. Experience delivering data-intensive financial products, credit risk solutions, consumer reporting systems, scorecards, predictive models, or alternative data products. Knowledge of FCRA, consumer reporting regulations, permissible purpose requirements, and model governance practices Experience in the financial services, insurance, and/or banking industry. Bachelor s degree required. Proven ability to work effectively across complex, matrixed environments. 
Preferred: Experience with using multiple different alternative data sources in products SAFe PO/PM certification, CSPO or related product management certification Experience with cloud services in GCP or AWS Experience supporting development, deployment, or operationalization of credit scores, risk models, or machine learning solutions Experience with Alternative Credit data sources, consumer reporting agencies, lending ecosystems, or financial decisioning platforms Experience modernizing legacy credit or financial services platforms and migrating data processing solutions to cloud environments

title: Deputy General Manager - Network, AI  & Strategic Collaborations
description:
Role Summary We are looking for a Deputy General Manager who will own a portfolio of strategic technology programmes at Tata Communications, ranging across network products, AI solutions, security and trust, and emerging federated network architectures. The role is equally about deep solutioning and broad collaboration : the successful candidate will architect end-to-end solutions for senior internal stakeholders and enterprise customers, drive multiple high-impact strategic partnerships in parallel (OEMs, hyperscalers, academia, standards bodies, customer co-innovation), and translate Tata Communications' technology strategy into measurable commercial outcomes. The successful candidate will be equally credible in a customer CTO conversation, an OEM negotiation, an engineering design review, and a board-level update. Key Responsibilities Solutioning and Solution Architecture. Architect and orchestrate end-to-end solutions for enterprise and carrier customers across the full Tata Communications portfolio connectivity, security, AI infrastructure, data platforms, and emerging federated architectures. Lead deep technical discussions with senior management, customer CXOs, and Tata Communications' executive committee. Translate complex requirements into deployable architectures with clear commercial and operational implications. Strategic Collaborations and Partnership Portfolio. Own and drive a portfolio of high-impact strategic collaborations across multiple counterpart types: OEMs and technology vendors evaluation, onboarding, joint roadmaps, joint go-to-market. Hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) — joint solutions and integrated offerings. Academic institutions — research collaborations with the IITs, IISc, and international universities on emerging technology (quantum, post-quantum, AI, networking). Standards bodies and industry consortia — ITU-T, ETSI, IETF, TM Forum, GSMA, and equivalent. Customer co-innovation programmes — joint design and pilot engagements with strategic enterprise and carrier customers. The candidate will manage several of these collaborations concurrently, set the strategy for each, negotiate technical and commercial terms, and drive them through to measurable outcomes. Productization of AI Workloads. Oversee the productization of AI workloads — model serving, agentic systems, AI-augmented network and security operations, and customer-facing AI features — on Tata Communications infrastructure. Define product requirements, drive engineering execution, manage release governance, and own commercial readiness, including performance, observability, cost, and responsible-AI compliance. Productization of Federated, Intent-Driven Network Programmes. Lead the productization of one or more flagship network programmes that couple multi-domain connectivity, security and identity, federated governance, and intent-driven orchestration across the underlay and overlay. Current programmes include Quantum-Safe Networking, intent-based and policy-driven network automation, SASE evolution, and federated network and data architectures across enterprise and carrier customers. The candidate will be expected to own one of these as the primary workstream while contributing to the others as their portfolio matures. Solutioning Excellence with OEMs and Partners. Convert OEM and partner capabilities into deployable Tata Communications solutions: identify integration points, design joint solution stacks, lead proof-of-concepts, and drive the implementation lifecycle with partner and internal engineering teams. Ensure that partner relationships translate into customer-facing value rather than abstract MOUs. Internal Cross-Functional Leadership. Build durable cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Architecture, Product Management, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Procurement, and Customer Success. Operate as a credible bridge between technical and commercial functions and as a senior-management-facing voice for the product portfolio. Strategy Execution and Results Ownership. Translate organisational strategy into measurable outcomes. Maintain quantitative dashboards on adoption, deployment, revenue impact, customer satisfaction, partner health, and programme execution. Drive quarterly business reviews and proactively unblock cross-functional dependencies. Operate with a clear "outcomes over activity" discipline. Talent and Technical Leadership. Mentor solution architects, product managers, and engineering leads in your matrix. Set the bar for technical depth, customer empathy, partnership stewardship, and executive communication. Champion a culture of solutioning excellence and strategic clarity. Required Qualifications Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics & Communication, Information Technology, or a closely related engineering discipline from a recognised institution. A management qualification (MBA, PGDM, or equivalent) is strongly preferred — the role explicitly requires a mix of computer-science depth and management acumen. Experience: 12–16 years of progressive experience in enterprise network products, telecom infrastructure, AI/ML productization, cloud platforms, or cybersecurity, with at least 4 years at a senior individual-contributor or leadership level driving cross-functional and cross-organisational initiatives. Technical depth in at least three of the following: Networking and connectivity — SD-WAN, SASE, SR-MPLS / SRv6, intent-based and policy-driven network automation (e.g., RFC 9315 IBN, TMF921), streaming telemetry (gNMI / OpenConfig), programmable data planes. Security, identity and trust — Zero Trust, identity and access management, federated identity (e.g., W3C DID and Verifiable Credentials), post-quantum cryptography, key and secret management. AI/ML productization — model deployment, MLOps, agentic systems, observability, responsible AI. Federated and decentralised data architectures — domain-oriented decentralised data ownership, federated data and policy governance, data-as-a-product thinking, policy-as-code. Cloud and hyperscaler architectures — AWS, Azure, GCP; multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud connectivity; service mesh and microservice patterns. Demonstrated track record of: Taking products from concept through commercial deployment at meaningful scale. Driving multiple strategic collaborations in parallel — OEMs, hyperscalers, academia, or standards bodies. Engaging at CXO level both internally and with enterprise customers. Operating in a matrixed, multi-stakeholder environment. Preferred Qualifications Exposure to federated data and policy architectures, decentralised data ownership models, or domain-oriented data platforms. Familiarity with intent-based networking standards (RFC 9315, TMF921), service-mesh patterns applied to network functions, or programmable data planes (P4 / eBPF). Familiarity with Quantum-Safe Networking, post-quantum cryptography, or QKD. Hyperscaler partnership experience (AWS, Azure, GCP) at the product-engineering level. Established relationships with global networking, security, or AI OEMs. Active participation in standards bodies or industry consortia. Academic-industry collaboration experience (joint research programmes, sponsored research, joint publications). Industry recognition through patents, peer-reviewed publications, standards contributions, or conference talks. MBA from a Tier-1 institution (IIM-A/B/C/L/I, ISB, INSEAD, Wharton, Booth, or equivalent). Prior experience in a Tier-1 telecom operator, cloud hyperscaler, networking OEM, or AI infrastructure company. Behavioural Competencies Self-motivated — operates with high agency across multiple parallel workstreams; does not require oversight to make progress. Strategy-driven — translates ambiguity into clear, executable plans across diverse programmes. Results-oriented — committed to measurable outcomes over activity. Executive communication — credible and concise with senior leadership, OEM executives, customer CXOs, and academic principals. Partnership stewardship — builds and sustains long-term collaborative relationships with external counterparts. Stakeholder management — earns trust across engineering, product, sales, partners, customers, and standards / academic communities. Intellectual curiosity — actively tracks emerging technology (AI, post-quantum, 6G, federated architectures, agentic systems) and brings external insight back into the organisation. Comfort with ambiguity — thrives at the intersection of new technology, evolving markets, and multi-counterparty dependencies.

description:
Role Summary/Purpose In this role you will be responsible for developing Concepts and Design Requirements for Energy management applications installed on locomotives. In this role you will work closely with a team of Software Engineers, QA Engineers, System architects, System Engineers, and Product Managers. 
 Essential Responsibilities 
 Drive the execution of design, analysis, or evaluation of assigned projects using sound engineering principles and adhering to business standards, practices, procedures, and product / program requirement Be responsible for System / Subsystem Level Design requirements for Energy management features and functionalities by providing the Design concepts, detailed design requirements on DOORs, Product Descriptions, ICDs, FMEA’s, Sub system design documents and other input documents. Define and manage Interfaces to all sub-systems in compliance to the system solution. Support and work with Software and validation engineers in developing the feature/functionality enhancement and solutions. Help define System Validation Plans and work with Validation Engineers to ensure traceability between the design requirements and test plans to verify cross references. Participate as a presenter or reviewer in technical and program reviews. Take ownership of technical concepts, solution, risks / mitigation plans, and engineering cost estimates on proposals. Maintain broad awareness of technical trends to ensure technical quality excellence, timely completion of work, and reviews and responsiveness to customer / program needs. Provide effective and timely communications on significant issues or developments. 
 Eligibility Requirements: 
 Must be willing to work out of an office located in Bangalore, India 
 Qualifications / Requirements 
 Bachelor’s / Masters’ degree in Controls / Electronics / Computer science disciplines. Minimum of 6-9 years of technical experience along with established technical leadership credentials across Locomotive / Automotive / Aerospace product lines. Minimum of 5 years’ hands-on design and implementation experience involving; Embedded systems design & software development. 
 Technical Expertise: 
 Strong technical knowledge in embedded systems design and development concepts. Expertise in System design and Validation on systems involving Real time Embedded Systems, Energy management / Optimization techniques. Knowledge on Real time operating systems like QNX and/or Linux. Strong knowledge of Protocols & Standards: Expertise in Data Distribution Service (DDS) alongside standard protocols like MQTT, CAN bus, Ethernet, TCP/IP, or REST APIs. Expertise in Service oriented architecture for Embedded Systems: Deep understanding of service autonomy, composability, and loose coupling adapted for distributed embedded platforms (e.g., SOME/IP, Adaptive AUTOSAR etc.) Experience in understanding and translating customer requirements into functional requirements and providing design solutions. Experience with INCOSE system engineering standards, DOORs classic and Next gen. Experienced in Model based designs in MATLAB/Simulink and embedded programming. Experience with System Testing Processes, Tools, and Automation. Business Acumen: Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and cross-functional communication skills. Skilled in breaking down problems, documenting problem statements, and estimating efforts. Demonstrates knowledge of technologies in the market to help make design recommendations, scope MVPs, and to drive timely decisions. Demonstrated ability to anticipate future needs, requirements, or course corrections necessary before they are articulated by stakeholders. Ability to implement customer and industry standards and work in a cross-functional, global environment. Leadership: Ability to take ownership of complex/medium sized or incompletely defined tasks. Demonstrates clarity of thinking to work through limited information and vague problem definitions. Delivers while mentoring and helping junior team members. Relentless drive and desire for continuous improvement. Challenges the status quo and pursues opportunities to drive service evolution, quality and efficiency while removing waste and non-value-added work from team activities. Continuously measures deliverables against commitments. Effectively balances multiple, different and/or competing objectives. Personal Attributes: Ability to engage and build positive relationships with both internal/external customers and peer groups. Self-motivated with the ability to lead and drive the effort with minimum supervision. Excellent oral and written communication skills Strong interpersonal skills Effective team building and problem-solving abilities. Pushes self for results; pushes others for results through team spirit and exhibiting role model behavior.

description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
   

  

 This Position reports to:
   

  

 R\&D Team Manager
   

  

  

  

  

  

**What We Believe In**
 ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.
   

  

 We deliver automation, electrification, and digital solutions across process, hybrid, and maritime industries through advanced industrial software, distributed control systems, quality control solutions, and analytics technologies that accelerate digital transformation and operational excellence.
   

  

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 In this role, we are looking for an R\&D Engineer – System 800xA \& Quality Control System (QCS) to join our Process Industries Digital Organization. You will contribute to the validation, testing, and lifecycle support of ABB System 800xA and Quality Control System (QCS) solutions, ensuring high\-quality, reliable, and secure industrial automation software for the Pulp \& Paper industry.
   

  

 Working as part of a collaborative Agile engineering team, you will develop and execute comprehensive validation strategies, perform end\-to\-end system integration testing, and collaborate with Product Management, Development, Commissioning, and global R\&D teams to deliver robust automation solutions while driving continuous quality improvements.
   

  

 This role is contributing to the Process Industries – System 800xA \& QCS Research \& Development organization in Bangalore, India.
   

  

 The work model for the role is: Hybrid
   

  

**You will be mainly accountable for**
* Develop and execute comprehensive validation strategies for System 800xA and Quality Control System (QCS) solutions by performing functional, integration, regression, system, cybersecurity, and end\-to\-end testing to ensure product quality, reliability, and compliance with ABB engineering standards.
* Validate industrial automation solutions by testing DCS integrations, QCS control strategies, process parameters, alarm management, historical data, industrial communication, and overall system performance across diverse operating scenarios.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Software Development, Commissioning, and global R\&D teams to manage defect lifecycles, support release readiness, participate in Agile ceremonies, and deliver high\-quality software using modern testing methodologies, Azure DevOps, and AI\-assisted engineering practices.
* Drive engineering excellence by developing test automation frameworks, improving validation processes, mentoring team members, maintaining technical documentation, supporting customer demonstrations, and promoting continuous improvement initiatives.


**Qualifications For The Role**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience in software testing or validation for Industrial Automation, DCS, PLC, SCADA, or Quality Control Systems, with hands\-on experience in ABB System 800xA, AC 800M, and Control Builder M.
* Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies including functional, system, integration, regression, simulation, and end\-to\-end validation, along with experience using Azure DevOps, Git/TFS, and test automation frameworks.

About Us Jar is India s leading Daily Saving app that helps people build strong saving habits-one small step at a time. Our goal is to make saving simple, rewarding, and truly life-changing.
